title: Control in one shorter sitting
subtitle: A shorter sitting for when control is already close
description: A short return for the hour when control is already in the hands and jaw. It loosens the grip before management becomes the day's mood.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Control softens when the heart stops trying to run the whole room.
